target.statement: Regression tree model predicting number of atoms from 14 original properties on QM7b test set: MSE = 0.1397, RMSE = 0.3737, MAE = 0.2451, R = 0.9906

compute.basis: QM7b is small (7211 molecules, 14 features); regression tree training and evaluation take seconds, but the paper provides no code, so the agent must implement preprocessing, UMAP embedding (for the 2-feature variant), and tree model from scratch, plus download data.

blockers: No code or configuration provided; must reimplement preprocessing, UMAP, and regression tree pipeline
Exact random 90/10 split and tree hyperparameters unspecified, so exact metric values may not be reproducible
title: Understanding the Structure of QM7b and QM9 Quantum Mechanical Datasets Using Unsupervised Learning
